sources.title: Congressional Review Act Revocation of 2024 Review of Final Rule Reclassification of Major Sources as Area Sources Under Section 112

status_summary: Public Law 119-20 (S.J. Res. 31), approved 2025-06-20, disapproved EPA's September 2024 rule that had required certain reclassified sources to keep meeting major source standards, and it has no force or effect. EPA then published a rule on 2026-01-02, effective the same day, that removes the 2024 amendments and restores the text of the 2020 reclassification rule. Under the Congressional Review Act a substantially similar rule cannot be reissued without new statutory authority.
